title: Face Cleanse Hydrating Cleanser + Makeup Remover
descriptionHtml:
✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Alcohol Free✓ Fragrance Free✓ Liquid Formula✓ Oil Free

What it is: A gentle cleanser that removes 100 percent of makeup, oils, and SPF, while cleansing and hydrating your skin without leaving it feeling tight or dry.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily


Formulation: Liquid


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Trealix: Instantly hydrates the skin within 30 seconds.

- Glycerin: Absorbs water like a magnet to intensely hydrate and visibly plump the skin.

- Oil-like Emollients: Melt off makeup while moisturizing the skin.


Ingredient Callouts: It is also gluten-free and cruelty-free.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use as part of morning and evening skincare routine.
-Pump a generous amount of formula into hands and lather with warm water.
-Apply on dry skin, massaging in circular motions until the serum transforms to foam.
-Rince with water and pat face dry.
Ingredients+
-Trealix: Hydrates the skin within 30 seconds.
-Glycerin: Absorbs water like a magnet to intensely hydrate and visibly plump the skin.
-Oil-Like Emollients: Melt off makeup while moisturizing the skin.

Aqua/Water/Eau, Dimethicone, Potassium Cocoyl Glycinate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate, PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Propanediol, Acrylates Copolymer, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Styrene/Acrylates Copolymer, Hydrolyzed Vegetable Protein, Sodium Chloride, Glycerin, Trehalose, Citric Acid, Sodium Hydroxide, Caprylhydroxamic Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Caramel.
